sentences.en: A moral monopoly is the antithesis of a marketplace of ideas.
sentences.zh: 道德垄断与思想市场的对立面。

sentences.en: When it reaches the marketplace our product will go like hot cakes.
sentences.zh: 等产品进入市场肯定能大卖。

sentences.en: The marketplace is the city's central public square.
sentences.zh: 这个城市的中央公共广场就是市场。
